info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Regulatory Reporting Amendments API
info.description: The Regulatory Reporting Amendments API facilitates the modification of previously submitted regulatory reports. By utilizing this endpoint, users can submit amendments related to specific submissions identified by their unique submission IDs, ensuring that regulatory compliance is accurately maintained. This API is essential for financial institutions and compliance officers who need to address errors or updates in their reports. Typical use cases include correcting data, adding information, or responding to regulatory feedback, providing a streamlined process for managing reporting accuracy.

post.summary: Submit an amendment for a regulatory reporting submission.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit an amendment for the regulatory reporting submission identified by RES-100045. Users should provide the necessary data in the request body to ensure the amendment is processed correctly, adhering to regulatory requirements.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit amendments for the regulatory reporting submissions identified by RES-100045. The request should contain the necessary details in JSON format to reflect the amendments being made.
